title: 第85章 尽量保他一个全尸！
novel_title: 唐逸孔诗岚全文完结版
content_zh: 这段时间，唐敬都快烦死这个一反常态处处和他作对的儿子了。　　无论在外还是在内，他都不想听到这个儿子的半点消息。　　他被关进了锦衣卫？要是真被关进去，那就好了。　　最好关个十年八年的，免得这逆子处处和他作对，烦人。　　当然，这事是不能让柳老夫人知道的，不然还怎么拿柳公瑾和柳文彦的命，来拿柳家的传家之宝呢？　　“什么？文彦那孩子也被抓进锦衣卫了？”　　唐敬装的一副震惊的样子，道：“娘，咱们进去说吧，你老身体不好，就别站着了。”　　亲手将柳老夫人扶到府中坐下，唐敬亲手给她倒了一杯茶，道：“娘，这事怪我，是我管教不严，这让唐逸惹祸连累到文彦的。”　　柳老夫人抬头：“惹祸？”　　“嗯，前两日他们在幻音坊惹了祸。”　　唐敬知道唐逸在幻音坊和刘州起冲突的事，因为这事，刘温这段时间见到他都咬牙切齿，恨不得和他拳脚相向。　　“幻音坊的背景……很强，连我也很忌惮。”　　唐敬脸色有些阴沉，道：“这兔崽子也真是的，他早告诉我说彦儿也被抓了的话，我和锦衣卫要人的时候，连彦儿也一起要出来了。”　　“结果，救他出来了，他愣是一个字都不说。”　　唐敬不喜欢柳家，将就趁这个机会，让唐逸和柳家彻底断了联系。　　同时，也断了唐逸的后路。　　果然听到这话柳老夫人眉头不由皱了起来，虽然唐敬说的话她不全信，可要是唐逸真被捞出来了，他都应该将文彦被抓的事说出来啊！　　就算唐敬不管，他也可以找柳家，和柳家说清楚被抓的原因。　　但是，唐逸一个字都没说。　　难道以前听话懂事的孩子，现在真的变坏了？　　姜氏眼眸闪了闪，抬头看天，一阵心虚。　　唐逸在锦衣卫事，昨日她已经从报信的人那里知道了，只是为了增加老夫人的危机感，她懒得说。　　再说唐逸胆小懦弱，能成个屁的事。　　“娘，小逸不会做这种事。”沈氏却很笃定，她相信唐逸。　　“呵，大夫人的意思是，我夫君说谎吗？”　　颜霜玉不屑地撇了撇嘴，不屑道：“你们柳家现在落魄得狗都不进，我夫君还有必要骗你们吗？”　　说到这里，颜霜玉走到唐敬的身侧，脸上充满得意和嘲讽。　　“当年我进京都，你们口口声声说我是乡下的女人，可我这个乡下的女人，大儿子三元及第，二儿子是名动京都的豪商巨贾，三儿子更是戍边大将军。”　　“呵呵，柳家书香门第名门望族，结果有柳家血统的唐逸，却是这样一个垃圾白眼狼。”　　“啧啧，如玉姐姐在天之灵，不知道该会有多失望啊！”　　当年她进唐家遭到柳家的羞辱，如今终于换了回去，感觉那是一个神清气爽，浑身舒畅。　　呵，当年你们瞧不起我？现在，我让你们高攀不起。　　柳老夫人脸色难看，女儿被如此贬低，她心头怒火中烧，手下意识地攥紧了拐杖。　　沈氏看到唐敬只是端起茶杯轻抿一口，并没有阻止颜霜玉，心中了然，颜霜玉对柳家的羞辱，是唐敬放纵的。　　他也在报复柳家！　　可没有柳家帮助，他唐敬能坐到今天吏部侍郎的位置吗？　　沈氏心头的火也是蹿了起来，正想反唇相讥，唐画三元及第？要是唐逸也有同等的教育，他不见得会比唐画差。　　只是话没说出口，柳老夫人已经抬手抓住她的手腕，轻微地摇了摇头。　　想要求人，就得有被人羞辱的准备。　　老夫人是已经有了准备，只是抬头看向坐在对面的唐敬时，心中依旧被无尽的怒火和屈辱吞噬，因为这个虚伪的男人，她在一年的时间，失去了丈夫和最疼爱的女儿。　　而现在，为了救孙儿和儿子，她又不得不求这个男人。　　老夫人只见微微颤抖，嘴巴张了几次，沙哑的声音才响起：“唐大人，不知能否帮忙疏通下，救一下文彦。”　　“至于公瑾……可能的话，尽量帮保他一个全尸。”　　昨晚想了一夜，老夫人已经想不到任何破局的方法了。　　她想过去求求贤妃，贤妃和女儿是最要好的朋友，求贤妃肯定是有希望的。　　可是，后宫不得干政，要是贤妃替柳公瑾求情，恐怕会被群起而攻之。　　她不能因为自己的儿子，而害得贤妃失宠，甚至被打入冷宫。　　听到老夫人这话，沈氏痛苦地闭上了眼睛。　　她的丈夫……难道真的没救了吗？　　唐敬端着茶杯的手微微一顿，嘴角微不可察地扬了扬。　　等的就是你这句话！　　“娘，你别这么说，柳家的事，能帮我肯定会帮……”　　唐敬放下茶杯，面色平静。　　只是不等他说完，颜霜玉一把抱住他的手臂，道：“相公，你忘记了他们当初是怎么对你的了吗？你凭什么帮他们？”　　“当初他们为了面子，求陛下下旨申饬你，差点让你前途尽毁。”　　“要不是你有本事，现在早不知道被流放去哪里了呢！”　　“现在他们说帮，你就帮？”　　颜霜玉抱着手，睨着柳老夫人：“柳老太太，求人，就该有求人的态度。”　　“你女儿已经死了，你柳家和我们唐家，已经没有什么羁绊了。”　　“想要我相公帮你救人？可以，但求人……得跪下求。”　　柳老夫人佝偻的身体顿时颤了颤。　　沈氏脸色铁青，挡在了柳老太太的面前：“唐大人，管好你的女人，如玉虽然走了，但她还有儿女在，我娘，还是你母亲。”　　“要娘跪下来求你，你受得起？”　　唐敬抬头看向沈氏，眼中有冷意：“哦？大嫂是来请我办事的？还是来教我办事的？”　　“如果是来教我办事的，那就请吧，我唐敬做事，还轮不到别人指手画脚。”　　“你……”沈氏脸色骤冷。　　“哎呀大嫂，你就少说两句吧！”　　姜氏拉住沈氏，道：“咱们今日过来，就是来求唐大人帮忙救小逸和大哥的，不是来给唐大人脸色看的。”　　“一切，还是都听母亲的吧！”　　颜霜玉戏谑盯着柳老太太，老太太却平静看着唐敬。　　今日她若跪，柳家将再无半点脸面，以前的美誉都将会成为射向柳家的刀。　　可她不跪，柳公瑾必死无疑，极有可能还会连累孙子柳文彦。　　柳文彦要是死了，柳家的传承可就断了。　　“唐大人，老身跪着求你，是否能救回我孙儿？”　　老夫人攥紧手杖沉声问道。
content_en: During this time, Tang Jing was almost bored to death with his son who was always against him.Whether outside or inside, he didn't want to hear any news about his son.He was imprisoned in Jinyiwei?It would be great if he was really imprisoned.It's best to lock him up for ten or eight years, lest this traitor will always oppose him and become annoying.Of course, Mrs. Liu cannot know this, otherwise how could she risk the lives of Liu Gongjin and Liu Wenyan to get the Liu family’s heirloom?"What? Wen Yan's kid was also arrested and taken into Jinyiwei?" Tang Jing pretended to be shocked and said, "Mom, let's go in and talk. You are not in good health, so don't stand there." He helped Mrs. Liu to sit down in the house with his own hands. Tang Jing poured her a cup of tea with his own hands and said, "Mom, this is my fault. I'm in charge.The lack of strict teaching caused Tang Yi to get into trouble and bring trouble to Wenyan." Mrs. Liu raised her head and said, "Trouble?" "Well, they got into trouble at Huanyinfang two days ago." Tang Jing knew that Tang Yi had a conflict with Liu Zhou in Huanyinfang. Because of this, Liu Wen was gnashing his teeth when he saw him during this time, and he wanted to fight with him."The background of Huanyinfang... is very strong, even I am very afraid of it." Tang Jing's face was a little gloomy, and he said: "This bastard is really serious. If he had told me that Yan'er was also arrested, Jin Yiwei and I would be asking for someone.By that time, Lian Yan'er was about to come out."In the end, he was rescued and didn't say a word."Tang Jing didn't like the Liu family, so he took this opportunity to completely cut off contact between Tang Yi and the Liu family.At the same time, Tang Yi's escape route was also cut off.Sure enough, Mrs. Liu frowned when she heard this. Although she didn't believe everything Tang Jing said, if Tang Yizhen was fished out, he should tell the story about Wen Yan's arrest!Even if Tang Jing doesn't care, he can still go to the Liu family and explain to them the reason for being arrested.However, Tang Yi didn't say a word.Could it be that the obedient and sensible children before have really turned bad now?Ms. Jiang's eyes flashed and she looked up at the sky, feeling guilty for a while.Tang Yi was in Jinyi Guards. She had already found out from the person who reported the news yesterday, but just to increase the old lady's sense of crisis, she didn't bother to say anything.Besides, Tang Yi is timid and cowardly, and it can be a big deal."Mom, Xiaoyi wouldn't do such a thing." Shen was very sure, she believed in Tang Yi."Oh, Madam, do you mean that my husband lied?" Yan Shuangyu curled her lips disdainfully and said disdainfully: "Your Liu family is so depressed now that even dogs can't get in. Do you still need my husband to lie to you?" At this point, Yan Shuangyu walked up to Tang Jing's side, her face full of pride and ridicule."When I came to Kyoto, you kept saying that I was a woman from the countryside, but I am a woman from the countryside. My eldest son was born in Sanyuan, my second son was a wealthy businessman who was famous in Kyoto, and my third son was a general who guards the border." "Haha, the Liu family comes from a scholarly and prestigious family, and the result isTang Yi, who is from the Liu family, is such a trashy white-eyed wolf."Tsk, tsk, Sister Ruyu is in the spirit of heaven. I don't know how disappointed she must be!"She was humiliated by the Liu family when she entered the Tang family, but now that she has finally returned, she feels refreshed and comfortable.Oh, you looked down on me back then?Now, I am putting you beyond your reach.Mrs. Liu's face was ugly. Her daughter was so belittled. She was filled with anger and subconsciously tightened her grip on the crutch.When Shen saw that Tang Jing just picked up the tea cup and took a sip, but did not stop Yan Shuangyu, she knew in her heart that Yan Shuangyu's humiliation to the Liu family was due to Tang Jing's indulgence.He is also taking revenge on the Liu family!But without the help of the Liu family, would Tang Jing be able to sit in the position of Minister of the Ministry of Civil Affairs today?The fire in Shen's heart also jumped up, and she was about to retort, "Tang Hua Sanyuan?"If Tang Yi also had the same education, he might not be worse than Tang Hua.But before the words were spoken, Mrs. Liu raised her hand to grab her wrist and shook her head slightly.If you want to demand things from others, you must be prepared to be humiliated.The old lady was already prepared, but when she looked up at Tang Jing sitting opposite, her heart was still swallowed up by endless anger and humiliation. Because of this hypocritical man, she lost her husband and her most beloved daughter in one year.And now, in order to save her grandson and son, she had to beg this man.The old lady trembled slightly, opened her mouth several times, and then her hoarse voice sounded: "Master Tang, I wonder if you can help to clear the way and save Wen Yan." "As for Gong Jin...if possible, try to save his whole body." After thinking about it all night last night, the old lady could not think of any way to break the situation.She wanted to go and ask for help from Concubine Xian. Concubine Xian and her daughter were the best friends, so there was definitely hope for Concubine Xian.However, the harem is not allowed to interfere in politics. If a virtuous concubine pleads for Liu Gongjin, she might be attacked by a group of people.She couldn't let the virtuous concubine fall out of favor or even be thrown into the cold palace because of her son.Hearing what the old lady said, Mrs. Shen closed her eyes in pain.Her husband...is it really hopeless?Tang Jing's hand holding the teacup paused slightly, and the corners of his mouth raised imperceptibly.That’s what I’m waiting for!"Mom, don't say that. If you can help me with the Liu family's affairs, I will definitely help..." Tang Jing put down his teacup with a calm expression.Before he could finish speaking, Yan Shuangyu hugged his arm and said, "Mr. sir, have you forgotten what they did to you in the first place? Why do you help them?" "For the sake of face, they begged His Majesty to issue an order to warn you, which almost ruined your future." "If it weren't for your ability, I don't know where you would have been exiled by now!" "Now he isIf you ask for help, you will help." Yan Shuangyu held her hands and looked at Mrs. Liu: "Mrs.Liu, you should have the attitude of asking for help." "Your daughter is dead, and there is no bond between your Liu family and our Tang family." "You can, but you have to kneel down to ask for help." Mrs. Liu's body suddenly trembled.Shen's face was ashen and she stood in front of Mrs. Liu: "Master Tang, take care of your woman. Although Ruyu is gone, she still has children. My mother is still your mother." "Can you bear it if you ask me to kneel down and beg you?" Tang Jing looked up.
title_en: Chapter 85 Try to keep his body intact!
